plan.title: School Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Enrolment trends, infrastructure gaps, and gender comparison

panels.title: Monthly trend
panels.sql: SELECT "Survey Round" AS month, SUM("Households surveyed") AS total FROM "district_health_factsheet" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average score by site
panels.sql: SELECT "School Name" AS site, AVG("Girls 2022" + "Girls 2023" + "Girls 2024" + "Boys 2022" + "Boys 2023" + "Boys 2024") / 6 AS avg_score FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 schools by total enrolment
panels.sql: SELECT "School Name", ("Girls 2022" + "Girls 2023" + "Girls 2024" + "Boys 2022" + "Boys 2023" + "Boys 2024") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard shows the overall student count across all schools, highlighting the scale of enrolment. A line chart tracks the monthly surveyed households to illustrate data collection activity over time. Bar visualisation ranks schools by their average enrolment, giving a quick view of the most active institutions. Finally, a table lists the top ten schools by total student numbers, providing a concise reference for resource allocation.
